summary: National Guard troops continue to remain stationed in D.C. more than a year after their deployment, with advocates arguing the situation underscores the need for statehood, while statehood supporters are working to build momentum for the cause ahead of midterm elections and securing commitments from elected officials. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
